summary: BioForce NanoScience Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to voluntarily disclose board and advisory board changes. The company appointed Scott Mager as General Counsel on May 19, 2026 and as a director on June 15, 2026, and named Richard Kaiser as interim CEO on June 17, 2026. It also established an Advisory Board and appointed Stuart Yarbrough and Edward Mathias for three-year terms. No financial terms, transactions, or strategic events are described; the filing is purely informational regarding personnel changes. No special-situation category applies.
